answer: Coordination leaks through identical answer style or timing across thousands of aliases, and that fingerprint is exactly what marks them as one attacker — the more coordinated the farm, the easier it is to detect. This is why the honest majority can be small yet decisive: each vote carries the weight of verifiable work, not just the noise of a large flock.. The defense holds because trust accrues slowly and is lost fast, so a farm that ever submits a copied answer destroys the value of that identity. Consider a dune as the anchor of the cost.
